transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Alvarez, the Battalion Maintenance Control Officer. Before we get into the specifics of tomorrow's maintenance board, I'd like to hear from the maintenance chief and operations liaison on their current records. We've got G-17 and G-22 both scheduled for corrective maintenance, and three qualified technicians available for the day. Let's make sure we're all synced up before I publish the work sequence, assignments, and return-to-service times.
